name: Alphalete - SEO Audit 2026-09-11
body:
> Audit · Alphalete · 2026-09-11

# Summary
A read-only SEO performance audit prepared Sep 11 2026 across GSC, Search Atlas/OTTO, WordPress (wp-cli), a 194-URL live crawl, 9 uploaded GA4 PDFs and a read-only Google Ads check. Verdict: **mixed**. Visibility rose sharply, clicks did not follow, and leads could not be measured. It produced a 30-issue tracker, a 139-URL baseline, a 53-row keyword opportunity tracker, a change log and an HTML dashboard ("Alphalete Search Health").

# Key findings
- **Visibility up:** GSC impressions 4.4K to 24.5K (+457%), Aug 12 to Sep 8 vs Jul 15 to Aug 11. Indexed pages 19 (Jul 27) to 79 (Sep 4). YoY average position 45.6 to 20.3.
- **Clicks flat to down:** 62 to 38, mostly the internal Philippines drop (38 to 10). US clicks 21 to 25.
- **CTR collapse explained:** 57% of impressions (13,889) came from `/blog/what-is-trenchless-sewer-repair/` ranking about position 23 nationally; 1 click.
- **Money pages invisible:** 7 of 8 service URLs were "Discovered - currently not indexed", never crawled.
- **Leads unmeasurable:** GA4 showed 0 key events everywhere; the Ads landing page `/pipelining/` (192 of 247 ad clicks) had no GA4 tag; Direct (66.6% of sessions) had unexplained spikes.
- **OTTO hidden content** (`display:none`) on 5 URLs, including an out-of-market keyword ("trenchless contractor durango co") and a hidden 11-question FAQ with matching schema. Spam-policy risk.
- OTTO controls the SEO head; Rank Math not installed, Yoast inactive. OTTO-reported meta descriptions did not render on home and Contact.

# Issue tracker (30 issues)
| Priority | Issues | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | I01 hidden OTTO content, I02 service pages not indexed, I03 nav link to redirect, I04 GA4 zero key events, I05 paid LPs missing GA4, I06 home/contact meta missing, I09 pros-and-cons post lost impressions | I01 and I03 marked Done Sep 11; I02 in progress |
| P2 | I07 89 URLs without meta, I08 drafted post now 404, I10 phone inconsistency, I11 near-duplicate commercial city pages, I13 links to redirects/404s, I14 sitemap junk, I15 drain page localized to Denver, I16 orphaned commercial x city pages, I17 blog cannibalization, I20 lead forms on 3 pages only, I21 risky pending OTTO items, I22 warranty / 50-year claims, I23 GBP mismatch, I24 legacy root blog URLs, I25 internal traffic | I13 in progress, I14 Done |
| P3 | I12 small-town pairs overlap, I18 long blog titles, I19 multiple H1s on 16 posts, I26 Direct/Unassigned source, I27 speed, I28 almost no authority (1 external link, authority 2), I29 WordPress timezone UTC, I30 Search Atlas GSC page endpoint broken | Open |

Note on I19: the duplicate H1s were found on blog posts and `/free-video-inspection/`. The June 23 audit had already reported the old `cdp-text-overlay` duplicate H1 as gone, though `copy-delete-posts` still appears in the Sep 11 active plugin list (`source-data\wp_env.txt`).

# Decisions and status
- Top three actions named: remove OTTO hidden content, get service pages crawled and indexed, fix GA4 measurement.
- The change log CSV has one row so far (2026-10-07 llms.txt claim cleanup).
- Most issues stayed Open as of the tracker's last save (Sep 12).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `Alphalete-SEO-Performance-Report.md`: the full written report (exec summary, scope, data windows, GSC/GA4 findings).
- `Alphalete-SEO-Issue-Tracker.csv`: 30 issues with evidence, priority, fix, metric, status.
- `Alphalete-SEO-Performance-Baseline.csv`: 139 URLs with status, index state, GSC metrics.
- `Alphalete-Keyword-Opportunity-Tracker.csv`: 53 query rows with cannibalization and action.
- `Alphalete-SEO-Change-Log.csv`: change log template plus the Oct 7 entry.
- `alphalete-search-health.html`: the "Alphalete Search Health" dashboard.
- `notes\`: `gsc_notes.md`, `ga4_notes.md`, `analysis.txt` (working notes and crawl analysis).
- `fix-backups\2026-09-11_otto-hidden-content\`: see [Alphalete - Fix Log](lib:brain-alphalete-fix-log).
- `scripts\` (6 Python scripts) and `source-data\` (crawl JSON, GA4 exports, sitemap URLs, wp_env): raw inputs, no notes.
